
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/flyingnosky/p/19419667" title="发布于 2025-12-30 10:10">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">Linux调度分析（2）调度用户态API介绍</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<p>Linux调度的实现在内核中，但用户态可以通过调度相关的systemcall可以进行调度相关的设置。这些设置包括：</p>
<ol>
<li>设置调度策略<br>
设置调度策略通过系统调用函数sched_setscheduler()实现，它的函数定义如下：<br>
<code>SYSCALL_DEFINE3(sched_setscheduler, pid_t, pid, int, policy, struct sched_param __user *, param)</code><br>
pid为需要设置的线程pid，policy为需要设置的调度策略，param为设置参数<br>
Linux调度policy包括：</li>
</ol>
<ul>
<li>SCHED_NORMAL：普通调度</li>
<li>SCHED_FIFO：先进先出调度</li>
<li>SCHED_RR：Round-robin调度</li>
<li>SCHED_BATCH: ?</li>
<li>SCHED_IDLE：idle调度</li>
<li>SCHED_DEADLINE: DL调度</li>
<li>SCHED_EXT：EBPF调度</li>
</ul>
<ol start="2">
<li>
<p>获取调度策略<br>
获取调度策略通过系统调用函数sched_getscheduler()实现，它的函数定义如下：<br>
<code>SYSCALL_DEFINE1(sched_getscheduler, pid_t, pid)</code></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>设置亲和性<br>
设置线程的亲和性，可以让线程运行在指定的CPU上，它是通过系统调用sched_setaffinity()实现，它的函数定义如下：<br>
<code>SYSCALL_DEFINE3(sched_setaffinity, pid_t, pid, unsigned int, len, unsigned long __user *, user_mask_ptr)</code></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>获取亲和性<br>
获取线程的亲和性可以通过系统调用sched_getaffinity()实现，它的函数定义如下：<br>
<code>SYSCALL_DEFINE3(sched_getaffinity, pid_t, pid, unsigned int, len, unsigned long __user *, user_mask_ptr)</code></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>放弃当前CPU运行<br>
系统调用sched_yield()可以让当前运行的线程放弃在当前CPU的运行，切换其他线程运行<br>
<code>SYSCALL_DEFINE0(sched_yield)</code></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>其他的系统调用<br>
除了上述系统调用外，还有其他系统调用如：</p>
</li>
</ol>
<ul>
<li>sched_get_priority_max()获取某个调度策略的最大priority值</li>
<li>sched_get_priority_min()获取某个调度策略的最小priority值</li>
<li>nice()修改当前线程的priority值</li>
<li>sched_setparam()/sched_getparam设置/获取线程的priority</li>
<li>sched_setattr()/sched_getattr()设置/获取线程的扩展属性</li>
<li>sched_rr_get_interval()返回线程默认的slice即调度时间片</li>
</ul>
<ol start="7">
<li>隐式的调度相关的操作<br>
上述系统调用明确调用了调度相关的系统调用，其实在用户态调用sleep()等函数时隐含着schedule()让当前线程主动让出CPU的调度操作。</li>
</ol>
<p>下面代码是设置pid为10000的线程调度相关的设置：将其设置为SCHED_FIFO调度策略，获取SCHED_FIFO的最大和最小优先级，设置线程的亲和性（将其绑定到CPU 0），在做了一些循环操作后放弃当前CPU。</p>
<p>`...</p>
<p>static void die(const char *msg)<br>
{<br>
perror(msg);<br>
exit(EXIT_FAILURE);<br>
}</p>
<p>int main(void)<br>
{<br>
int ret;<br>
pid_t pid = 100000;  // 100000 means "this process"</p>
<pre><code>/* -----------------------------
 * 1. Set scheduling policy
 * ----------------------------- */

struct sched_param sp;
memset(&amp;sp, 0, sizeof(sp));

// Choose a real-time policy, e.g., SCHED_FIFO or SCHED_RR.
// NOTE: This usually requires root privileges.
int policy = SCHED_FIFO;

// Get allowed priority range for this policy
int max_prio = sched_get_priority_max(policy);
int min_prio = sched_get_priority_min(policy);

if (max_prio == -1 || min_prio == -1) {
    die("sched_get_priority_*");
}

// Use some priority in the valid range; here we just pick the max.
sp.sched_priority = max_prio;

ret = sched_setscheduler(pid, policy, &amp;sp);
if (ret == -1) {
    // If you see EPERM, you likely need to run as root.
    fprintf(stderr,
            "sched_setscheduler failed: %s (need CAP_SYS_NICE/root for RT)\n",
            strerror(errno));
    // Not fatal for demonstration, continue with default policy.
} else {
    printf("Scheduler set to policy %d, priority %d\n", policy,
           sp.sched_priority);
}

/* -----------------------------
 * 2. Set CPU affinity (pin to CPU 0)
 * ----------------------------- */

cpu_set_t set;
CPU_ZERO(&amp;set);
CPU_SET(0, &amp;set);  // bind to CPU 0

ret = sched_setaffinity(pid, sizeof(set), &amp;set);
if (ret == -1) {
    die("sched_setaffinity");
} else {
    printf("Affinity set to CPU 0\n");
}

/* -----------------------------
 * 3. Do some work and yield
 * ----------------------------- */

for (int i = 0; i &lt; 5; ++i) {
    printf("Iteration %d on CPU %d\n", i, sched_getcpu());

    // Do some dummy work
    for (volatile long j = 0; j &lt; 100000000L; ++j)
        ;  // busy loop

    printf("Yielding CPU...\n");
    ret = sched_yield();  // Let other runnable tasks run
    if (ret == -1) {
        die("sched_yield");
    }
}

printf("Done.\n");
return 0;
</code></pre>
<p>}`</p>

</div>
